ignore_udp.description: Disable detection for UDP traffic (set to true to ignore UDP packets).

ignore_icmp.description: Disable detection for ICMP traffic (set to true to ignore ICMP packets).

ignore_hosts.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges to exempt from scanning detection (e.g., trusted internal networks).

scan_mode.description: Which traffic to monitor: 'tcp' (TCP SYN, FIN, etc.), 'udp' (UDP), or 'both'.

block_host.description: Automatically block detected attackers (by adding to /etc/hosts.deny or firewall rules).

block_time.description: Duration (seconds) to block a host before unblocking (set 0 for permanent block).

kill_cmd.description: Custom command to run when blocking a host (e.g., for alerting or logging).

tcp_ports.description: TCP ports to monitor for scanning (lower-numbered services are common targets).

udp_ports.description: UDP ports to monitor for scanning.

strict_tcp_scan.description: Enable detection of non-standard TCP scans (XMAS, NULL, FIN, SYN-ACK, etc.).

strict_udp_scan.description: Enable detection of suspicious UDP patterns (e.g., fragmented packets, unusual ports).

stealth_scan_threshold.description: Number of connection attempts per host within the detection window to trigger an alert.

detection_window.description: Time window (seconds) during which connection attempts are counted for scan detection.

max_connections.description: Maximum connections allowed per host before triggering an alert.

log_file.description: Path to the file where portsentry writes scan detection events.

alert_email.description: Email addresses to notify when a port scan is detected (requires working SMTP).

smtp_server.description: SMTP server host for sending alert emails.

alert_subject.description: Subject line prefix for alert emails.

pre_block_cmd.description: Command to run before blocking a host (e.g., to log or notify).

post_block_cmd.description: Command to run after blocking a host (e.g., to update firewall rules).

always_ignore.description: Hosts to never alert on (even if detected) — e.g., backup systems or monitoring agents.

tcp_conn_limit.description: Max TCP connections per host before flagging as suspicious (separate from scan detection).

udp_packet_limit.description: Max UDP packets per host before flagging as suspicious.

advanced_logging.description: Include timestamps, source IP, port, and scan type in log entries.

hosts_deny.description: Path to the TCP wrappers hosts.deny file used for blocking (if `block_host=true`).

enable_ipv6.description: Enable detection of IPv6 port scans.

ignore_ipv6.description: IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges to exempt from scanning detection.

syslog_alert.description: Syslog command to send alerts (e.g., 'logger -p auth.alert -t portsentry').

ignore_ports.description: Ports to ignore scanning alerts for (e.g., common false positives like SNMP).

scan_white_list.description: List of trusted hosts (IPs or CIDRs) that are allowed to scan.

resolve_hosts.description: Resolve connected client IPs to hostnames (adds latency).

max_threads.description: Maximum worker threads (0 = auto-detect based on CPU count).

run_as_user.description: Unix user to run the daemon as (for security — avoid 'root').

run_as_group.description: Unix group to run the daemon as.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used for daemon management.

exit_after.description: Seconds to run before exiting (0 = run continuously as daemon).

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to portsentry (e.g., ['-ignore', '127.0.0.1']).

active_probe_ports.description: Ports to actively probe to detect stealth scans (e.g., honeypots).

active_probe_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between active probes to honeypot ports.

promisc_ports.description: Ports to monitor in promiscuous mode for deep packet inspection.

listen_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor (empty = all interfaces).

udp_tracking.description: Enable tracking of UDP session state for anomaly detection.

tcp_tracking.description: Enable tracking of TCP session state for anomaly detection.

aggressive_mode.description: Enable higher-sensitivity detection (may increase false positives).
